pages.ja: 降りた。
pages.jaRuby: 降りた。
pages.en: I descend.
pages.mirrorMoon: I jump down.

pages.ja: 階段なんて使っていられなかった。
pages.jaRuby: 階段なんて使っていられなかった。
pages.en: There is no time to use the stairs.
pages.mirrorMoon: I don’t even use the stairs.

pages.ja: 気が付けば五メートルの高さから、遠坂の真後ろに飛び降りていた。
pages.jaRuby: 気が付けば五メートルの高さから、遠坂の真後ろに飛び降りていた。
pages.en: Before I know it, I have leapt from five meters above and landed directly behind Tohsaka.
pages.mirrorMoon: I have jumped down behind Tohsaka without even knowing it.

pages.ja:
だがそこまで。
遠坂の後頭部に食らいつこうとした葛木の蛇によって、木刀は粉砕された。
pages.jaRuby:
だがそこまで。
遠坂の後頭部に食らいつこうとした葛木の[ruby text=こぶし]蛇によって、木刀は粉砕された。
pages.en:
And that is as far as I get.

Kuzuki's fist, a striking serpent poised to sink its fangs into the back of Tohsaka's head, shatters my wooden sword.
pages.mirrorMoon:
But that’s it.
My wooden sword is destroyed by Kuzuki’s fist, going for Tohsaka’s head.

pages.ja:
「え？」
突然の乱入者に目を見張る。
その中で一人、当然のように動く敵がいた。
pages.jaRuby:
「え？」
突然の乱入者に目を見張る。
その中で一人、当然のように動く敵がいた。
pages.en:
“What?”

Every eye widens at the sudden intruder.

Only one enemy moves as though nothing unexpected has happened.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“What?”
Everyone’s astonished by the sudden intruder.
Except for one man, who reacts as though it’s perfectly natural.

pages.ja:
「
」
躊躇などない。
この男には相手が誰であろうと関係ない。
突如現れた衛宮士郎に抱く感慨などない。
pages.jaRuby:

」
躊躇などない。
この男には相手が誰であろうと関係ない。
突如現れた衛宮士郎に抱く感慨などない。
pages.en:
“————————”

He does not hesitate.

The identity of his opponent means nothing to this man.

The sudden appearance of Shirou Emiya inspires no feeling in him at all.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
He does not hesitate.
It does not matter for this man who the enemy is.
He has no emotion for the one who appeared.

pages.ja:
打ち出される死神の釘。
防ぐ手段などない。
茎のように首を折られる。
なんて無様。
わずか二秒も保たないのでは意味がない。
俺は、このまま。
何も出来ず、遠坂さえ助けられない
却下。
手段ならば初めから持っている。
防ぐ手段などそれこそ無数に用意できる。
この体が魔術師ならば。
戦うのは体ではなく、魔術によって創り出したモノに他ならない
！

pages.en:
The Reaper's nail flies toward me.

I have no means of defending myself.

My neck will snap like the stem of a flower.

How pathetic.

Surviving for less than two seconds means nothing.

I will die here,

without accomplishing anything, without even saving Tohsaka——

——Denied.

The means has been mine from the beginning.

I can make any number of things to defend myself with,

if this body is that of a mage.

A mage fights not with his own flesh, but with the things his magecraft creates——!
pages.mirrorMoon:
Death’s scythe is thrust.
There’s no way to block it.
I’ll have my neck snapped like a flower.
How pitiful.
It’s meaningless if I won’t last even two seconds.
I…
…Will not be able to do anything, not even save Tohsaka
No.
I had a way from the start.
I can prepare numerous things to block the attack.
If I am a magus…
What does the fighting is not my body, but something I make out of magic!

pages.ja:
「
投影、開始」
ならば作れ。
成功など当然だ。
復元するのは基本骨子からではない。
（危険）
その概念、創作者の思想思惑道徳信仰から起源そのものを読み込む。
（危険）
故に復元ではなく投影、其は真物より落ちる同一の影。
pages.jaRuby:
「
[ruby text=トレース char=2]投影、[ruby text=オン o2o=1]開始」
ならば作れ。
成功など当然だ。
復元するのは基本骨子からではない。
（危険）

（危険）

pages.en:
“——Trace, on.”

Then make them.

Success should be a matter of course.

What I restore does not begin with the fundamental structure.

　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　*(Danger)*

I read the concept itself: the creator's thought, intention, morality, faith, and even the work's origin.

　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　*(Danger)*

Therefore this is not restoration, but Projection—the identical shadow that falls short of the genuine article.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Trace, on.”
Then make it.
Success is a matter of course.
Do not reconstruct it from the basic structure.
Read its concept, the maker’s thought, expectation, moral, faith, and the origin itself.
That is why it is not reconstruction, but projection. It is an equal shadow cast by the true object.

pages.ja:
（危険）
それがいかなる領域の業であろうと関係ない。
一度成したモノならば、再現するに支障など
！
（暴走）
pages.jaRuby:
（危険）
それがいかなる領域の業であろうと関係ない。
一度成したモノならば、再現するに支障など
！
（暴走）
pages.en:
*(Danger)*

It does not matter how far beyond me the craft may lie.

If I have made it once, nothing can prevent me from reproducing it——!

　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　*(Runaway)*
pages.mirrorMoon:
It does not matter how great the work is.
If it has been accomplished, there is no problem with recreating it!

pages.ja:
問題は別にある。
そう、問題は、問題は問題は、問題は問題は問題は機能に筐体がついてこれないというコトだけ。体が熱い。
細胞という細胞が発火する。神経は阿鼻を訴え網膜は罅割れ乾き心音は消失する。
肉体の停止命令を無視し、創造における理念、基本となる骨子、構成する材質、制作の為の技術、憑依された経験、蓄積した年月、その手順を一息に省略して干将莫耶を作り出す。

pages.en:
The problem lies elsewhere.

Yes, the problem—the problem, the problem, the problem, the problem, the problem is only that the vessel cannot keep pace with its function. My body is hot.

Every cell ignites. My nerves howl of hell, my retinas crack and dry, my heartbeat disappears.

Ignoring the body's command to cease, I collapse every step into a single breath—the principle behind their creation, their fundamental structure, their component materials, the technique by which they were made, the experience instilled within them, the years they accumulated—and bring forth Kanshou and Bakuya.
pages.mirrorMoon:
There
But there
is another problem.
Yes, the problem is, the problem is the problem is, the problem is the problem is the problem is that the unit cannot keep up with the function. My body is burning.
Every cell in me catches fire. My nerves let out agonizing cries, my retina cracks and dries, and my heartbeat disappears.
I ignore my body’s order to stop. The concept of creation, the basic structure, the composition material, the skill of its making, the experience of its growth, the accumulated years, I skip it all and make up Kanshou and Bakuya.

pages.ja:
全身が燃える。
いま投影を使う、という事は死ぬということ。
そんな規格外の魔術行使、衛宮士郎の肉体は耐えられない。
それを無視して頭は先走り、故に肉体は死滅する。
pages.jaRuby:
全身が燃える。

それを無視して頭は先走り、故に肉体は死滅する。
pages.en:
My whole body burns.

To use Projection now is to die.

Shirou Emiya's body cannot withstand magecraft so far beyond its specifications.

My mind races ahead in defiance of that truth, and so my flesh perishes behind it.
pages.mirrorMoon:
My whole body is burning.
Using projection now means dying.
Emiya Shirou’s body cannot handle such magic.
My head ignores it, and therefore, my body will die.

pages.ja:
だが。
その問題さえ、問題である筈がない。
そう、そんな筈がない。
pages.jaRuby:
だが。
その問題さえ、問題である筈がない。
そう、そんな筈がない。
pages.en:
——But.

Even that should present no problem.

Yes. There is no reason it should.
pages.mirrorMoon:
But.
That cannot be a problem.
No, it cannot be.

pages.ja:
剣製を行えば死ぬ？
まさか。
この体は、その点においてのみ特化した魔術回路。
剣に助けられ、剣と融合に生きてきた。
故に
他の人間ならいざ知らず、こと剣製で、衛宮士郎が自滅する事などありえない
！
pages.jaRuby:

まさか。

！
pages.en:
——Creating swords will kill me?

Impossible.

In this one respect alone, this body is a Magic Circuit refined for a single purpose.

I was saved by a sword. I have lived as one with swords.

Therefore——whatever might happen to anyone else, I—Shirou Emiya—could never destroy myself through the creation of a sword——!
pages.mirrorMoon:
I will die if I reproduce swords?
Of course not.
This body is a Magic Circuit specialized for this purpose alone.
I have been saved by swords, and I have lived with swords.
I do not know about others, but it is impossible for me to destroy myself by reproducing swords!

pages.ja:
「はっ
…………！！」
弾く。
手にした得物が同じなら、対峙する敵も同じ。
手にあるのは干将莫耶。
複製されたアーチャーの宝具は、再度、葛木の拳を弾ききっていた。

pages.en:
“Hah——…!”

I deflect it.

The weapon in my hands is the same. The enemy I face is the same.

I hold Kanshou and Bakuya.

The replicas of Archer's Noble Phantasms turn Kuzuki's fists aside once more.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Hah……!!”
I repel it.
The same weapons are in my hands, and my enemy is the same.
Kanshou and Bakuya are in my hands.
The reproduced Noble Phantasm of Archer has repelled Kuzuki’s fist once again.

pages.ja:

」

pages.jaRuby:

“————————”

——That stops him.

Perhaps judging that matters would repeat our last encounter, Kuzuki opens the distance slightly.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
It stops right there.
Kuzuki must have figured out this would turn out like last time, as he takes a step back.

pages.ja:
「は

pages.jaRuby:

“Ha——gh…!”

My lungs explode.

The breath that had stopped bursts from my mouth like water through a broken dam.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Haa, guh……!”
My lungs explode.
The breath I’ve been holding escapes my mouth in a rush.

pages.ja:
左肩の感覚はない。
傷は完全に開ききり、ぬらりと、包帯だけでなく服さえ血で染めていた。
pages.jaRuby:
左肩の感覚はない。
傷は完全に開ききり、ぬらりと、包帯だけでなく服さえ血で染めていた。
pages.en:
I can no longer feel my left shoulder.

The wound has opened completely. Blood has soaked not only the bandage, but even my clothes.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I don’t feel my left shoulder.
My wound has completely opened up and the blood stains not only my bandage, but my shirt as well.

pages.ja:
投影によるダメージではない。
二撃。
葛木の拳を二回弾いただけで、左腕は潰された。
もう一撃受けていれば肩の骨は外され、拳に殴られたというのに腕が弾ける、なんて奇怪な光景が展開されただろう。
pages.jaRuby:
投影によるダメージではない。

もう一撃受けていれば肩の骨は外され、拳に殴られたというのに腕が弾ける、なんて奇怪な光景が展開されただろう。
pages.en:
——The damage is not from Projection.

Two blows.

Merely deflecting Kuzuki's fist twice has ruined my left arm.

One more would have dislocated my shoulder, producing the grotesque spectacle of an arm bursting apart merely because a fist struck it.
pages.mirrorMoon:
It’s not damage brought on by using the projection magic.
Two attacks.
I only repelled Kuzuki’s attack twice and my shoulder got destroyed.
I bet my shoulder would have been dislocated with one more attack, and my arm would have
been ripped off.
split open.

pages.ja:
「っ

」
そんな内情を明かす訳にはいかない。
双刀を構えたまま、遠坂の背中を守る。

“Gh——haah, haah… ha——”

I cannot allow them to know any of that.

Keeping the twin blades raised, I protect Tohsaka's back.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Haa, haa, ha”
I can’t show that.
I ready my twin swords and protect Tohsaka’s back.

pages.ja:
その、肝心の遠坂は、
「ば、ばか士郎
！ アンタ、なんだってこんなところに来てんのよ……！」
足を止めて、憎まれ口を、たたいていた。

pages.en:
And the Tohsaka whose safety matters so much——

“Y-you idiot, Shirou——! Why the hell did you come here…!?”

has stopped to hurl abuse at me.
pages.mirrorMoon:
And Tohsaka is…
“Y-You idiot! Why are you here…!?”
She has stopped and is complaining to me.

pages.ja:
「
」
……ほっとする。
この選択に、間違いはなかった。
こいつの、この判りづらい人の良さを失わないで、本当に、良かった。
pages.jaRuby:

」

こいつの、この判りづらい人の良さを失わないで、本当に、良かった。
pages.en:
“————————”

…Relief washes through me.

This choice was not a mistake.

Thank God I did not lose this goodness of hers, so difficult for anyone to see.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
…I’m relieved.
My choice wasn’t wrong.
I’m glad her good-heartedness is still there.

pages.ja:
「
っ」
いや、今はそんな場合じゃない。
間違いでないかどうかはこの後だ。
俺たちはこのまま、無傷でここから外に出なくちゃいけないんだから。
pages.jaRuby:
「
っ」
いや、今はそんな場合じゃない。
間違いでないかどうかはこの後だ。
俺たちはこのまま、無傷でここから外に出なくちゃいけないんだから。
pages.en:
“————————!”

No. This is not the time for that.

Whether the choice was right will be decided afterward.

First, somehow, both of us have to make it out of here unscathed.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“!”
No, now’s not the time.
It’s too early to tell if my choice was right or not.
We have to get out of here alive.

pages.ja:
「
わるい、文句は後だ遠坂。一息つけたらちゃんと聞くから、今はアイツらをなんとかしよう」
遠坂は無言で頷いて、俺の後ろで臨戦態勢に入る。
pages.jaRuby:
「
わるい、文句は後だ遠坂。一息つけたらちゃんと聞くから、今はアイツらをなんとかしよう」
遠坂は無言で頷いて、俺の後ろで臨戦態勢に入る。
pages.en:
“——Sorry. Save your complaints for later, Tohsaka. Once we have room to breathe, I'll hear you out properly. For now, let's do something about them.”

Tohsaka nods in silence and assumes a fighting stance behind me.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Sorry, complain to me later, Tohsaka. I’ll listen once we get out of here, so let’s take care of them first.”
Tohsaka nods silently and readies herself behind me.

pages.ja:
「
手を出すと判ってはいたが。まさか、飛び降りるとは思わなかった」
拳を構えたまま、葛木は俺と遠坂を見据えている。
pages.jaRuby:
「

pages.en:
“——I knew you would intervene. I did not imagine you would leap down.”

Still holding his fists ready, Kuzuki studies Tohsaka and me.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I knew you were going to do something, but I did not think you would jump down.”
Kuzuki is watching us, his fists ready to fight.

pages.ja:
……俺たちを逃がす気はない。
こうして睨み合っているのは、どちらかを逃がさない為だ。
俺と遠坂、どちらかが動けば即座に反応してくるのだろうが

…He has no intention of allowing us to escape.

He maintains this standoff only to prevent either of us from fleeing.

The moment Tohsaka or I move, he will respond—but——

If either one of us moves, he should react right away

we cannot afford to wait him out.

This body was never going to last long.

If we mean to flee, we have to do it now.

“!”
But I can’t be taking my time.
…The wound on my shoulder is getting worse by the second.
My concentration fades as more blood is lost.
My body won’t last long to start with.
If we are to run, we should do so as fast as possible.

pages.ja:
……だが、簡単に逃げ出せる相手でもない。
俺が動けば葛木は当然反応する。そうなった時、まっさきに殺されるのは遠坂だ。
遠坂を逃がす為には葛木を倒すしかない。だが俺に葛木を倒す力はなく、敵は葛木だけではない。
pages.jaRuby:
……だが、簡単に逃げ出せる相手でもない。
俺が動けば葛木は当然反応する。そうなった時、まっさきに殺されるのは遠坂だ。
遠坂を逃がす為には葛木を倒すしかない。だが俺に葛木を倒す力はなく、敵は葛木だけではない。
pages.en:
…But he is not an opponent from whom we can simply run.

If I move, Kuzuki will respond. When he does, Tohsaka will be the first to die.

To let her escape, I have to defeat Kuzuki. I have no power to defeat him—and Kuzuki is not our only enemy.
pages.mirrorMoon:
…But we can’t run away that easily.
Kuzuki will react if I move. When that happens, Tohsaka will be the first one to die.
I have to defeat Kuzuki to let Tohsaka go. But I don’t have the power to beat Kuzuki, and he’s not our only enemy.

pages.ja:
葛木の背後にはキャスターと、裏切ったアーチャーがいる。
……いや、下手をすればセイバーまでも敵に回ってくるかもしれない。
pages.jaRuby:
葛木の背後にはキャスターと、裏切ったアーチャーがいる。
……いや、下手をすればセイバーまでも敵に回ってくるかもしれない。
pages.en:
Behind him stand Caster and the Archer who betrayed us.

…Worse, Saber may join them as our enemy at any moment.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Behind Kuzuki are Caster and the betrayer, Archer.
…No, in the worst case, Saber might also become our enemy.

“It appears to be over. Your interruption surprised me, but it changes nothing.

“…Yes, from the look upon your face, you have finally resigned yourself. By coming out here, you accepted that you might be killed. Is that not so, boy?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“That’s it. I was surprised by your intrusion, but the result does not change.
…Yes, it looks like you have given up. You came out, so you don’t mind dying, right?”

」

“I shall end matters here. Keeping you alive would only prove troublesome, so I may as well dispose of you together——”

“——!”

…It's coming…!

All that remains is to resist with everything I possess. I pour strength into the twin blades and stand before Tohsaka.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I shall end it here. It would be troublesome to keep you alive, so”
“!”
…She’s coming…!
I’ll resist with all my powers. I ready my twin swords and stand in front of Tohsaka.

放たれる殺気。
それが俺たちに到達する直前。
「
いいや。待て、キャスター」
感情のない声で、赤い騎士が場を制した。

pages.en:
Murderous intent is unleashed.

An instant before it reaches us——

“——No. Wait, Caster.”

The knight in red stills the chamber with an emotionless voice.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Released intent to kill.
Right before it reaches us…
“No. Hold on, Caster.”
The knight in red stops the attack with an emotionless voice.

pages.ja:
「……アーチャー。この場での発言権がないことぐらい、読みとってると思ったけど」
「いや、言い忘れていた事があった。おまえの軍門に下るには、一つだけ条件を付けたい」
「……条件、ですって？」
pages.jaRuby:
「……アーチャー。この場での発言権がないことぐらい、読みとってると思ったけど」
「いや、言い忘れていた事があった。おまえの軍門に下るには、一つだけ条件を付けたい」
「……条件、ですって？」
pages.en:
“…Archer. I thought you capable of discerning that you have no right to speak here.”

“No. There was one thing I neglected to mention. I would attach a single condition to my surrender.”

“…A condition?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…Archer. I thought you would know that you have no right to say anything here.”
“No, there is something I forgot to tell you. I want to give one condition for me to side with you.”
“…A condition?”

pages.ja:
「ああ。無抵抗でおまえに自由を差し出したのだ。
その代償として、この場ではヤツラを見逃してやれ。
どのみちマスターとしては機能しない者達だ。殺す価値はないだろう」
他人事のような提案。
それを、遠坂はまっすぐに見つめていた。
pages.jaRuby:
「ああ。無抵抗でおまえに自由を差し出したのだ。
その代償として、この場ではヤツラを見逃してやれ。
どのみちマスターとしては機能しない者達だ。殺す価値はないだろう」
他人事のような提案。
それを、遠坂はまっすぐに見つめていた。
pages.en:
“Yes. I surrendered my freedom to you without resistance.

“In exchange, spare them here and now.

“Neither can function as a Master any longer. They are not worth killing.”

He offers the proposal as though it concerned perfect strangers.

Tohsaka looks directly at him.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Yes. I gave you my freedom without resistance.
As compensation, I would like for you to let them go.
They are useless as Masters now. There is no merit to killing them.”
His proposal sounds objective.
Tohsaka watches it intently.

pages.ja:
「見逃せ、ですって？ ……ふん。言動のわりには甘いのね、貴方」
「私とて人の子だ。さすがに裏切った瞬間に主を殺した、では後味が悪い」
pages.jaRuby:
「見逃せ、ですって？ ……ふん。言動のわりには甘いのね、貴方」
「私とて人の子だ。さすがに裏切った瞬間に主を殺した、では後味が悪い」
pages.en:
“Spare them…? …Hmph. For all your conduct, you are surprisingly softhearted.”

“I too am human. Betraying my Master and killing her in the same instant would leave an unpleasant taste.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Let them go? …Heh, you are more good-natured than you act.”
“I was born as a human. It will leave a bad aftertaste if I kill my master right after I betray her.”

pages.ja: 「ふぅん。裏切り者のクセに、よく本人の前で人並みのコトを言えたものね」
pages.jaRuby: 「ふぅん。裏切り者のクセに、よく本人の前で人並みのコトを言えたものね」
pages.en: “My. A traitor who can speak of ordinary decency to his victim's face.”
pages.mirrorMoon: “Oh. You are a traitor, but you say such a thing in front of the one you betrayed?”

pages.ja:
「……いいわ。今回は見逃してあげましょう。けれど次に目障りな真似をしたら、誰が止めようと殺します。
それでいいかしら、アーチャー」
pages.jaRuby:
「……いいわ。今回は見逃してあげましょう。けれど次に目障りな真似をしたら、誰が止めようと殺します。
それでいいかしら、アーチャー」
pages.en:
“…Very well. I shall overlook you this once. But interfere with me again, and I will kill you no matter who tries to stop me.

“Is that acceptable, Archer?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…Fine. I shall let them go this time. But I will kill them if they get in my way again, no matter who stops me.
Is that fine, Archer?”

pages.ja: 「当然だ。この状況でなお戦いを挑むような愚か者ならば、手早く死んだ方がいい」
pages.jaRuby: 「当然だ。この状況でなお戦いを挑むような愚か者ならば、手早く死んだ方がいい」
pages.en: “Naturally. Any fool who would still challenge you under these conditions would be better served by a swift death.”
pages.mirrorMoon: “Of course. If they are stupid enough to continue fighting in this situation, they deserve to die.”

pages.ja:
……それで交渉は成立したのか。
聖堂に満ちていた殺気は薄れ、俺たちを逃がすまいとする圧迫感はなくなっていた。
pages.jaRuby:
……それで交渉は成立したのか。

pages.en:
…And with that, their negotiation appears to be concluded.

The murderous intent filling the sanctuary recedes. The pressure that had sealed every avenue of escape is gone.
pages.mirrorMoon:
…That must have concluded the negotiation.
The intent to kill filling the temple goes away, and the restraining enmity fades.

pages.en:
“You heard him, both of you. I shall allow you to go this once.

“Now leave as befits the defeated. Turn tail and run.”

“Gh——”

I glare at Caster.

…But Tohsaka silently takes hold of my arm.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“So that’s it, you two. I will let you go this time.
Now, run like the dogs you are.”
“!”
I glare at Caster.
…But.
Tohsaka pulls on my arm silently.

pages.ja:
「行きましょう。今はあいつの言う通りよ」
耳元で囁かれる声。
「
」
それに呼吸を鎮めて、目前の敵に背を向けた。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“Let's go. For now, he's right.”

Her voice is a whisper beside my ear.

“————————”

I steady my breathing and turn my back upon the enemy.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Let’s go. She’s right.”
She whispers in my ear.
“”
I calm down and turn my back to the enemy.

pages.ja:
走る事もせず、ゆっくりと階段まで歩いていく。
あれだけ遠かった距離は、わずか数歩で埋まった。
かつん、という足音。
遠坂は階段に足をかけ、一度だけキャスターへ振り返る。
……いや、それは違う。
遠坂が見据えた相手はキャスターではなく、敵側で微笑するあの男だ。

pages.en:
We do not run. We walk slowly toward the stairs.

The distance that seemed so immense closes in a handful of steps.

A hard footfall rings out.

Tohsaka places one foot upon the stairs and turns toward Caster a single time.

…No. That isn't right.

Her eyes are not fixed upon Caster, but upon the man smiling among the enemy.
pages.mirrorMoon:
We don’t run but slowly make our way to the stairs.
The distance that seemed so great is covered in just a few steps.
A footstep.
Tohsaka takes a step onto the stairs and turns back to Caster.
…No, that’s wrong.
Tohsaka did not look at Caster, but at the man smiling beside our enemy.

pages.ja:
「恨むのなら筋違いだぞ、凛。
マスターとしてこの女の方が優れていただけの話だ。
優劣が明確ならば、私は強い方をとる」
pages.jaRuby:
「恨むのなら筋違いだぞ、凛。

優劣が明確ならば、私は強い方をとる」
pages.en:
“Your resentment would be misplaced, Rin.

“This woman has simply proved the superior Master.

“When the balance is clear, I choose the stronger side.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“It is wrong to curse me, Rin.
It is just that this woman is a better Master than you are.
If the difference is clear, I will choose the stronger one.”

pages.ja:
「
そうね。けど後悔するわよ。わたしはぜったいに降りない。
いい、キャスターを倒してアンタを取り戻す。その時になって謝っても許さないんだから」
pages.jaRuby:
「
そうね。けど後悔するわよ。わたしはぜったいに降りない。
いい、キャスターを倒してアンタを取り戻す。その時になって謝っても許さないんだから」
pages.en:
“——Maybe. But you'll regret it. I will never back down.

“Listen to me. I'll defeat Caster and take you back. And when I do, don't expect me to forgive you just because you apologize.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“You’re right. But you’ll regret it. I will never give up.
I’m going to defeat Caster and get you back. I won’t forgive you even if you apologize to me at that time.”

「それは無駄骨だな。まあ、自殺するというのなら止めはしないが」
ふん、と顔を背けて歩き出す。
横顔は悔しげに唇を噛んでいた。
それでも足は速めず、遠坂は堂々とした足取りのまま、振り返らずに地下聖堂を後にした。

pages.en:
“A fruitless effort. Still, if you wish to kill yourself, I shall not interfere.”

With a snort, Tohsaka turns away and resumes walking.

Her profile is taut with frustration; she bites hard into her lip.

Even so, she does not quicken her pace. With her head held high, Tohsaka leaves the underground sanctuary without looking back.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“That is just vain effort. Well, I will not stop you if you want to throw away your life.”
She turns away and starts to walk.
She’s biting her lip in anger.
But she does not speed up, and Tohsaka leaves the underground temple in a magnificent manner.

pages.ja:
教会を出る。
地下聖堂からここまで、一度も言葉は交わさなかった。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
We emerge from the church.

Neither of us has exchanged a word since leaving the underground sanctuary.
pages.mirrorMoon:
We get out of the church.
We do not say anything.
